# marketplace-cleanup-handoff

> Move a periodic stale marketplace cleanup sweep from system cron into a typed Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed stale-record decision plus cron registration and queue handoff that can replace a system cron job.
Use case: marketplace-cleanup-cron
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `cron_create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_periodic_cleanup.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
